title: Prediction Ledger: Forward-Looking Claims with Testable Outcomes

predictions.claim: Humanoid robots scalable by 2030
predictions.test_metric: Do major robot companies (Tesla, Boston Dynamics, Figure AI) demonstrate sub-$150K/unit cost + 80%+ task automation by 2029?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (if cost ≤$150K and capability ≥80%) / FAIL (if cost >$200K or capability <60%)
predictions.subject: jensen-huang-lex-fridman-nvidia
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.narrative: Jensen discusses agentic architectures and tool-use, designed 2yrs before public disclosure. Vera Rubin/Rock rack designed for agentic tool use. Humanoid robotics is implicit corollary of 'intelligence requires manipulation' thesis.

predictions.claim: Value investing dead
predictions.test_metric: Russell 1000 Value outperforms Russell 1000 Growth cumulatively 2026-2030?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (if Value > Growth CAGR) / FAIL (if Growth > Value CAGR)
predictions.subject: reference_claim
predictions.speaker: reference
predictions.narrative: Reference example from Phase 4k prompt. Market regime test.

predictions.claim: Bitcoin $1-5T inflow from wealth transfer
predictions.test_metric: Young cohort (age 18-40) BTC allocation increases from 8% to 15%+ of investable assets 2026-2030?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (if adoption ≥15%) / FAIL (if adoption <10%)
predictions.subject: jack-mallers-ep113-bitcoin-bigger-shovel
predictions.speaker: Jack Mallers
predictions.narrative: Mallers: '$400-500T total addressable market for money. BTC at $1.5T has 200x+ purchasing power upside.' Implicit: younger cohorts adopt BTC faster than older cohorts. Measured by survey data (Fed, FT, Goldman Sachs wealth surveys).

predictions.claim: TikTok trend detection beats Wall Street by 2-4 weeks
predictions.test_metric: Camillo (or replication traders) identify 3+ trends on TikTok that drive 10%+ stock moves within 4 weeks?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (if 3+ confirmed) / FAIL (if 0-2 confirmed)
predictions.subject: reference_claim
predictions.speaker: reference

predictions.claim: STRC delivers equity returns + credit principal safety + tax efficiency simultaneously
predictions.test_metric: MicroStrategy STRC preferred outperforms Russell 2000 Value Index AND delivers <5% principal loss through 45% BTC drawdown AND maintains return-of-capital tax treatment through 2028?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (all three simultaneous) / FAIL (any one fails)
predictions.subject: saylor-digital-credit
predictions.speaker: Michael Saylor
predictions.narrative: Saylor: 'you get the equity returns with the credit safety at a lower tax rate.' Counter: 2022 near-insolvency, -91% MSTR drawdown, -77% BTC drawdown (past 45% threshold). Strong counter reduces confidence from 0.60 to 0.45.
red_flags: Tax treatment vulnerable to FASB + IRS change

predictions.claim: STRC 0% principal loss through 45% BTC drawdown
predictions.test_metric: STRC senior tranche survives a 45% BTC price decline without 1% principal loss?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (0% loss at -45%) / FAIL (any loss detected)
predictions.subject: saylor-digital-credit
predictions.speaker: Michael Saylor
predictions.narrative: Saylor: 'zero percent principal loss... 45% bitcoin drawdown'. Historical max drawdowns: 93% (2011), 84% (2014), 83% (2018), 77% (2022). Window is cherry-picked.

predictions.claim: 18-23% tax-equivalent yield on STRC
predictions.test_metric: STRC distributions classified as return-of-capital (not ordinary income) through 2030, producing 18-23% TEY for top-bracket investors?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (ROC treatment holds) / FAIL (reclassified to ordinary income)
predictions.subject: saylor-digital-credit
predictions.speaker: Michael Saylor
predictions.narrative: Saylor: '18 to 23 percent tax equivalent yield'. FASB ASU 2023-08 (effective Dec 2024) requires BTC mark-to-market. If BTC appreciates, Strategy generates distributable earnings → ROC→ordinary income conversion risk.

predictions.claim: Reflexive flywheel: credit + BTC + equity creates self-reinforcing value
predictions.test_metric: MSTR stock outperforms S&P 500 by >300% cumulatively 2026-2030 while maintaining 2+ turns of leverage on BTC?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (outperformance >300% AND leverage intact) / FAIL (underperformance or deleveraging)
predictions.subject: saylor-digital-credit
predictions.speaker: Michael Saylor
predictions.narrative: Saylor: 'issuing credit, buying bitcoin, creates more bitcoin, which creates more demand'. Counter: Luna/UST reflexive collapse May 7-13 2022: $40B→$0 in 5 days. Reflexivity amplifies in BOTH directions.

predictions.claim: NVIDIA reaching $3T annual revenue
predictions.test_metric: NVIDIA annual revenue reaches $3 trillion by 2030?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (if ARR ≥ $3T) / FAIL (if ARR < $2.5T)

predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.narrative: Jensen: '200-company supply chain, no physical limit.' FY2025 actual revenue ~$60B. Implies 50x growth in 5 years (53% CAGR). COI adjustment: -0.10.

predictions.claim: CUDA moat durable against platform-layer attacks
predictions.test_metric: NVIDIA retains >70% gross margin AND >40% of high-end AI accelerator market share through 2029?
predictions.outcome_criteria: PASS (both conditions met) / FAIL (GM drops below 65% OR share drops below 35%)

predictions.claim: Percentage of GDP used for computation will be 100x more than past

predictions.subject: jensen-huang-lex-fridman-nvidia
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.narrative: Jensen: 'computing shifted from retrieval-warehouse to generation-factory... 100x more than the past.' Regime-dependent: requires sustained AI investment + no major recession.

predictions.claim: Four scaling laws all live (pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic)

predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang

predictions.claim: Rack-scale co-design moat more durable than single-GPU performance

predictions.claim: Inference is thinking (defense against inference-ASIC threat)

methodological_notes.extraction_method: Phase 4k forward-looking claim mining from PRISM scratchpad outputs
methodological_notes.testability_filter: All predictions must have: (1) measurable outcome, (2) resolution date, (3) pass/fail criteria, (4) source traceability
methodological_notes.confidence_calibration: Default 0.60 → forward-looking claims; COI adjustments -0.05 to -0.15; implicit cap 0.50; promotion/hedging adjustments applied
methodological_notes.red_team_readiness: All predictions with impact ≥8 (19 total) flagged for Phase 2.5 adversarial review
methodological_notes.next_phase: Phase 4m: Quarterly prediction ledger update (add new claims as transcripts processed)
